content.title: https://www.quora.com/Who-is-the-oldest-cast-member-of-Friends/answer/Grace-Kelly-238
content.text: Born in 1963, Lisa Kudrow is the show's oldest cast member, while Matthew Perry, born in 1969, is the youngest. If you are asking about characters then- 1.) Monica says in Season 3 that it took her 28 years to find a guy she wanted to spend the rest of her life with: Richard. meaning Monica should've been 26 in Season 1. 2.) Rachel is the same age as Monica, which also would have made her 26. 3.) Ross says in the Pilot episode that he is 26. While it may seem confusing, considering Ross is a year older than Monica, it possibly means that Monica already celebrated her birthday that year, Ross not yet, meaning the Pilot occurs sometime in August-September. 4.) Chandler is a few months older than Ross, making him at least 26-27 in the beginning. 5.) In the beginning of Season 4, which counts as Season 3's year, Phoebe yells ather birth mother "You had 29 years to know that and you didn't even try." 29-3= 26, meaning she's 26. 6.) In Season 6, Rachel reminds Joey he's 31. 31-6= 25, making Joey the youngest in the group. Basically, Joey is the youngest, followed, by Monica, then Rachel, then Phoebe, then Ross,then chandler is the oldest one. Edit : Holy Shit!!! 8K views! It's amazing! Thank you so much!
